title: Compatibility of the normalized section pullback comparison
statement:
theorem section_pull_transport_condition_of_normalized {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (cX : ScalarSectionData a X) (cY : ScalarSectionData a Y)
    (hcX : ScalarSectionNormalized a X cX) (hcY : ScalarSectionNormalized a Y cY)
    (lam : D a Y ⋙ L Λ' f ≅ L Λ f ⋙ D a X) (hlam : PullNormalized a f lam)
    (barLam : cY.model.T ⋙ derivedPullback Λ' f ≅ derivedPullback Λ f ⋙ cX.model.T)
    (hnorm : SectionPullNormalized a f cX cY barLam) :
    PullSectionCondition a f cX cY lam barLam

proof.text: For a cochain representative whose internal scalar counit is invertible, apply section_pull_transport_condition_on_computed to the two endpoint normalizations and the supplied internal and section normalized comparisons.

Apply the existing source-library CondensedRing.exists_kFlat_iso_Qh_obj to represent any derived object by a K-flat homotopy object. Scalar extension preserves K-flat quasi-isomorphisms, so Functor.derives_kFlat.isIso_of_isLeftDerivedFunctor makes its scalar counit invertible. Represent that homotopy object by a cochain complex and apply the preceding pasting argument. Naturality of the two composite transformations transports the equality across the representative isomorphism to the original object.

statement_change.what: The endpoint derived isomorphisms in ScalarSectionData were unrestricted. SectionPullNormalized only constrains the ordinary isomorphisms and model counits, so changing an endpoint derived isomorphism preserves its hypotheses but changes the conclusion. Add ScalarSectionNormalized for both endpoints, already assumed by the parent transport theorem. The source comparison is normalized by these computation equations.
